_comment: Named server profiles. Use with: node src/index.js --profile <name>  (or set MC_PROFILE). A profile only overrides the fields it lists. Copy a profile and edit it for your own server - do not commit real addresses. `--server host:port` / MC_HOST+MC_PORT / MC_ADDRESS override the profile without touching this file.

local.description: The bundled headless 1.20.1 lab server started by npm start

example.description: Template for an external AuthMe multiplayer server - replace host/port, or pass them on the CLI. The in-game password belongs in MC_AUTHME_PASSWORD, never here.
